consumer.source: GOB 11 scales Super Jump 567 by 3 per learned rank. The stock forward jump uses the resulting live total to choose its destination.
consumer.runtime: AbilityPassives sends stat 567 on training and loadout changes. The server admits the stock destination and keeps it when the client reports its original takeoff point.
consumer.test: PR689 uses the same verified takeoff stand and Ctrl+Space at ranks 10 and 11. Source 11/567 changes +30 to +33. The client's destinations move 38.5 to 41.5 metres and both land, with ordinary movement from each destination. This covers the range consumer. Full peak and trajectory geometry remain unverified. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/689#issuecomment-7069839925

targeting.source: The stored direct selector, CastValidTarget 12, noncombat-only flag and 16 m range permit a live enemy simulacrum.
targeting.runtime: CoderPets checks the current view and spawn, live pet identity, hostile owner and range at admission and repeats those checks on landing. The normal ability handler admits it outside combat.
targeting.test: PR700 verifies stock local combat blocking, reasons 36/36/34 on a nonpet, friendly pet and out-of-range hostile pet with no debit or reuse, then hits only the selected nearby opponent's Nuker for 13000. The stock-layout replay verifies matching refusal and target frames, 40 IS, 2-second cast, 13.5-second reuse and removal of the selected pet alone. The exact retail opponent rules and lethal animation remain open. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/700#issuecomment-7070089764

behavior-tests.source: GOB 49 requires Evading, stores 20 IS, a 2-second cast, 8-second reuse and +25 Combat Evasion for 600 seconds. The init and term hooks toggle the blur bit.

behavior-tests.test: PR698 verifies the stock local state refusal, legal IS and reuse, the +25 record, and dismissal during Evade. The stock-layout replay verifies server refusal and cast length. ability-tactical-blur covers own/observer bit presentation and cleanup, and GaussianBlur49ClearsItsVisibleBitAndEvasionModifierAtExpiry covers the timed expiry. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/698#issuecomment-7069757538
